headline: Retrieve-for-Train compiles set-level retrieval behavior into a compact diffusion retriever
summary: Jiang et al. report Retrieve-for-Train (R4T), a pipeline that uses offline reinforcement learning to find set-valued query fan-out behavior, synthesizes training pairs from the optimized policy, and distills it into a 53.9M-parameter diffusion retriever. On author-run fashion and proprietary music retrieval evaluations, the paper reports improved set-level metrics for several model/task comparisons and 12–20× lower fan-out latency than autoregressive baselines for ten-way queries. These results are bounded to two retrieval regimes and do not establish transfer to web/RAG search or general reasoning.
